segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers describe the treatment as somewhat drying and prone to causing peeling or tightness, but several say pairing it with a moisturizer or reducing frequency keeps it manageable while still smoothing texture and softening fine lines.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation, redness or burning at all and call it gentle, while others describe retinol burn, flaking, or having to cut back to twice a week before their skin adjusted.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention aging or mature skin (ages roughly 37 to 82) report visible softening of fine lines, improved firmness and glow, though some in this group also report peeling or dryness during the adjustment period.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers using it for aging concerns report fewer or less visible fine lines, wrinkles, and improved firmness or plumpness over weeks to months of use; a few say it is too early to judge results.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers note the product itself can be drying, causing tightness or flaking, and recommend layering a moisturizer or reducing frequency; others report no dryness at all, especially when paired with a Lancer moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers report no redness or irritation even as sensitive-skin users, but a minority describe redness, burning, or a 'retinol burn' reaction, especially when starting with too much product or using it too frequently.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe temporary compromised skin — peeling, flaking, tightness, or an overall 'retinol uglies' phase — that several say resolved after adjusting frequency or amount, though one reviewer had a severe reaction requiring urgent care after misuse.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading of dark spots and improved evenness of skin tone, including brown spots and post-acne marks, with some seeing results as quickly as overnight or within two weeks.
concerns.blemishes: A couple of reviewers report the product helps clear breakouts and reduces redness of existing blemishes with consistent use.
concerns.oiliness: No reviews in this set discuss oiliness or oil control.

This is powerful stuff. I have used it once a week or less for the last year. Only because I wasn't sure if it did anything at all. Last week I decided to use it for a few days in a row and wow, I had a very surprising reaction. I noticed my forehead was starting to flake and around my eyes even though I didn't put it on my eyes. Long story short, I got out of the shower on the 4th day and went to apply my normal Lancer Nourish and my skin was on fire. Like acid. I washed it off but I couldn't use any of my moisturizing for about 4-5 days since it would burn. I think for me, my skin is sensitive to it, but I know, if I am careful and only use it occasionally, it is probably doing a lot of good work.
